xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2354: Needs-you push to the phone: Web Push sent from the machine with RFC 8291 encryption, optional ntfy

plan.title: Needs-you push to the phone: Web Push sent from the machine with RFC 8291 encryption, optional ntfy
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: When an agent or conversation asks a question, waits for approval, finishes or fails, nothing reaches the operator away from the screen. Desktop notifications need an open tab, there is no push code, and conversation AskUserQuestions have no server-side event at all.
narratives.Proposal: The dashboard server sends Web Push itself: a VAPID key created once, subscriptions bound to device credentials with an endpoint allowlist, payloads encrypted with RFC 8291 aes128gcm via web-push@3.6.7. A needs-you push service in the primary dashboard reads enrichment events, journal and heartbeat_dead events, a 5 s conversation feed scan that runs only when targets exist, and an instant wake from the AskUserQuestion hook. A pure classifier and dispatcher apply rising-edge dedup, startup priming and a 6-per-minute limit, then fan out to the webpush provider and an optional title-only ntfy provider behind a PushProvider interface that PAN-2080 reuses. Phones subscribe through a Turn on notifications control (Settings → Anywhere, and the PAN-2355 /m header) using the single /sw.js agreed with PAN-2355.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Slack, email and TTS providers (PAN-2080)
- vite-plugin-pwa, precache, offline support, extra icons, the /m phone shell and its ?subject= handling, the 3-tap answer flow (PAN-2355)
- A second service worker or any registration script URL other than '/sw.js'; replacing an existing sw.js or manifest
- Answering from the notification itself, or closing a notification after the item is answered elsewhere
- Quiet hours, digests, per-project routing
- Relay-delivered push or any overdeck.ai involvement
- VAPID key rotation
- Pushes from peer dashboards or for other linked machines' items
- Automatic Tailscale Serve setup (PAN-1254)
- Pricing copy in anywhere.mdx (W-DOC owner)
- Push for pendingPaneChoice, held kickoffs, rate limits, session-resume gates, verification.failed or plain agent.stopped
- Changes to settings-api.ts or ROUTE_SCOPES

autoDecisions.summary: Use web-push@3.6.7 for VAPID signing and RFC 8291 aes128gcm, sending with fetch
autoDecisions.rationale: Audited library; the PAN-2355 draft's D-5 forbids custom crypto; generateRequestDetails keeps timeouts and tests in our hands.

autoDecisions.summary: Detect conversation questions with a 5 s feed scan plus an instant wake from the AskUserQuestion hook heartbeat
autoDecisions.rationale: Conversations have no server-side AUQ event; the hook already POSTs ask_user_question_blocked, which the server dropped. The wake gives about 1 s latency for Claude Code, and the scan covers other harnesses within the 10 s done criterion.

autoDecisions.summary: Closed trigger list: AUQ and pan ask questions, plan and permission approvals, verification.started and merge.completed as finished, heartbeat_dead, merge.failed, review.stall-escalated and conflict.repair-escalated as failed
autoDecisions.rationale: Maps FR-15's four kinds onto events that reach the server today; pan done's activity events never reach the server process.

autoDecisions.summary: Payload is metadata-only by default; includePreview opts in to 140 characters of question text
autoDecisions.rationale: End-to-end encryption hides content from the push service, but the lock screen still shows it (old D-6, epic NFR-7).

autoDecisions.summary: push.enabled defaults to true; subscribing a phone or configuring ntfy is the opt-in, and with no targets nothing is scanned
autoDecisions.rationale: An extra enable switch adds a step without protecting anything.

autoDecisions.summary: VAPID subject defaults to https://overdeck.ai, configurable via push.webpush.subject
autoDecisions.rationale: Apple's push service rejects VAPID JWTs without a valid https: or mailto: subject; using the operator's email would leak it to push services.

autoDecisions.summary: Push config is edited in config.yaml and through /api/push routes; settings-api.ts is not touched
autoDecisions.rationale: settings-api.ts is at 1485 of a 1508-line cap; a dedicated config module and routes keep god files from growing.

autoDecisions.summary: Adopt the PAN-2355 planner's ownership split, payload contract {title, body, url, tag} and the /m?subject=<id> deep link
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator relayed both messages during planning; one service worker with a second-lander rule avoids duplicate workers and merge conflicts.

autoDecisions.summary: Endpoint allowlist of the four browser push services; subscriptions bound to the subscribing device credential
autoDecisions.rationale: Prevents SSRF through stored endpoints and honors the epic threat model: revoking a device stops its push.

metadata.sizeJustification: The issue's single done criterion (an AskUserQuestion reaches the installed phone within 10 s) needs server-side detection, RFC 8291 sending, subscription storage and routes, the service worker and the subscribe control together; none of these ships observable value alone. The work is decomposed into 16 small items with tight files_scope, and most files are new modules plus their tests.

items.title: Add web-push 3.6.7 runtime dependency and test-only decrypt dependencies

narrative.Action: PRD W1. Root package.json: add "web-push": "3.6.7" to dependencies; add "@types/web-push": "3.6.4" and "http_ece": "1.2.0" to devDependencies. Run bun install so bun.lock updates. Create the VAPID key pair once under OVERDECK_HOME/push with mode 0600

narrative.Action: PRD W4 and D-12. src/lib/push/vapid-keys.ts: pushDir() = join(getOverdeckHome(),'push'); vapidKeysPath(); readVapidKeys(); ensureVapidKeys() creates the dir 0o700, generates keys with webpush.generateVAPIDKeys(), writes vapid.json.<pid>.<uuid>.tmp at 0o600, link()s it to vapid.json, unlinks the temp, and on EEXIST re-reads and returns the existing keys. A malformed existing file throws VapidKeysUnreadableError and is never replaced. Use node:fs/promises only.

items.title: Given an empty OVERDECK_HOME, when ensureVapidKeys() runs, then push/vapid.json exists with file mode 0600

Persist push subscriptions with an endpoint allowlist, 20-record cap and credential binding

narrative.Action: PRD W5, D-13, D-14. src/lib/push/subscription-store.ts: validatePushEndpoint(url, extraHosts?) allows only https, port 443 or none, no userinfo, host fcm.googleapis.com | updates.push.services.mozilla.com | web.push.apple.com | *.push.apple.com | *.notify.windows.com. addPushSubscription({endpoint, keys{p256dh,auth}, label, credentialId}) validates p256dh (65 bytes, 0x04 prefix) and auth (16 bytes), upserts by id = sha256(endpoint) first 16 hex, caps at 20 distinct endpoints (subscription-limit). removePushSubscription, listPushSubscriptions, recordPushDelivery, subscriptionsPath. File <pushDir>/subscriptions.json written temp+rename at 0o600 behind a module-level promise chain.

Send RFC 8291 aes128gcm Web Push signed with VAPID to every live subscription

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Touches only its own new module and test; its inputs (types, vapid, subscriptions, config) are DAG predecessors.

narrative.Action: PRD W6, D-10, D-11, D-15. createWebPushProvider(deps?) -> PushProvider. For each subscription (Promise.allSettled): (1) if credentialId is set and listAccessTokens() has no such record or it has revokedAt, remove it and report revoked; (2) webpush.generateRequestDetails({endpoint,keys}, JSON.stringify({title:n.title, body:n.body, url:n.url, tag:n.tag}), {vapidDetails:{subject, publicKey, privateKey}, TTL:3600, urgency (high for question/approval/failed, else normal), topic (first 32 chars of base64url sha256(tag)), contentEncoding:'aes128gcm'}); (3) fetch with a 5 s AbortController timeout; (4) 2xx success; 404/410 remove the subscription; 429/5xx/network retry once after 5 s then transient; other 4xx rejected. Log only the endpoint host and id.

items.title: Given a subscriber ECDH key pair, when send() runs, then the captured body decrypted with http_ece (aes128gcm, subscriber private key, auth secret) deep-equals {title, body, url, tag} with exactly those four keys
Given the captured body, then it does not contain the title bytes in plaintext and decrypting it with a different ECDH key throws
Given a question notification, then the request headers include Content-Encoding aes128gcm, TTL 3600, Urgency high, and an Authorization header starting with 'vapid t='
Given a 410 response, then the subscription is removed; given 503 then 201, then fetch is called exactly twice and the second call happens only after advanceTimersByTimeAsync(5000)
Given a subscription whose device credential is revoked, when send() runs, then fetch is not called and the subscription is removed
Publish title-only needs-you messages to an optional ntfy topic

narrative.Action: PRD W7, D-8, D-10. createNtfyProvider(deps?) -> PushProvider. hasTargets() true only when ntfy.state === 'ready'. send(n) POSTs to `${url without trailing slash}/${encodeURIComponent(topic)}` with body n.publicTitle and headers Title: n.publicTitle, Priority '4' (question/approval/failed) or '3', Tags: kind, Click: clickBaseUrl + n.url only when clickBaseUrl is set, Authorization: Bearer token only when a token is set. 5 s timeout, one retry after 5 s on 429/5xx/network.

items.title: Given a notification whose title differs from publicTitle, when sent, then neither the request body nor any header contains n.title or n.body
Given no clickBaseUrl, then the request has no Click header; given no token, then it has no Authorization header
Given ntfy.state 'off', then hasTargets() resolves false and send() makes zero fetch calls
Given a 500 then 200 response, then fetch is called twice and the retry happens only after advanceTimersByTimeAsync(5000)

Given a conversation row named 'a.b' with pendingPermission.signature 'sig', then it yields perm:sig with url /m?subject=a.b; given a row with only pendingPaneChoice, then it yields no items
Given pipeline.journal events of each D-5 type, then each maps to the listed kind with url /m; given verification.failed or agent.stopped, then the result is null

Given includePreview false, then no notification body contains the question text and publicTitle never contains the conversation title; given includePreview true, then the body is at most 140 characters
Dispatch needs-you items with rising-edge dedup, startup priming and a 6-per-minute limit

narrative.Action: PRD W9, D-4, D-9. createNeedsYouDispatcher({providers, readConfig, now?, startedAt?}) -> {observeSubject(subject, items), observeEdge(notification), hasTargets(), stats(), dispose()}. Per-subject key sets: a key notifies when it first appears and is forgotten when it disappears; a key already active under any other subject is not sent again (a conversation can appear both as an enrichment agent and as a feed row). hasTargets() is false when cfg.enabled is false. Startup priming: items whose askedAt is more than 60 s before startedAt are recorded silently. Edge tags dedup for 24 h (max 500). Drop silently when !cfg.enabled or kind not in cfg.events. Rate limit 6 per rolling 60 s; over-limit items are counted and one summary '<N> more items need you' (url /m, tag summary) is sent when the window closes. Fan-out with Promise.allSettled; provider errors never propagate.

items.title: Given the same key observed twice, or observed under agent:conv-x and conv:x, then providers receive exactly one send; given the key removed everywhere and re-added, then they receive a second send
Given an item asked 5 minutes before startedAt, then nothing is sent; given an item asked after startedAt, then it is sent
Given events ['question'], then an approval item is not sent; given enabled false, then nothing is sent and hasTargets() resolves false
Given 8 new items within 10 s, then 6 are sent immediately and after advanceTimersByTimeAsync(60000) exactly one summary '2 more items need you' is sent
Given a provider whose send rejects, then observeSubject does not throw and stats().lastError is set

narrative.Action: PRD W10, D-3. New needs-you-push-service.ts: startNeedsYouPushService({readConversationFeed, store?, providers?}), stopNeedsYouPushService(), wakeNeedsYouPush(reason), getNeedsYouPushStatus(), sendTestPush() (title 'Overdeck test notification', body 'Push works on this device.', url /m, tag test; bypasses dedup and rate limit). Subscribe to the event store: agent.enrichment_changed -> observeSubject; agent.heartbeat_dead and pipeline.journal -> observeEdge; conversation.permission_changed with waiting true -> wake. A 5 s interval scans the conversation feed only when dispatcher.hasTargets() is true (success = status undefined and body is an array), clears vanished conv: subjects, and never overlaps. wake debounces 500 ms then scans and calls pollEnrichmentNow(). agent-enrichment-service.ts exports pollEnrichmentNow() guarded by an inFlight flag shared with the interval. main.ts starts it after startAgentEnrichmentService() only when !isPeerDashboard (passing getConversationsPendingInputFeed(conversationReadDependencies)) and stops it after stopAgentEnrichmentService().
